subject: Firesim cutover run: final checklist & smoke test readout
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Connor <alex.connor@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 16:08:00 -0000
Subject: Firesim run before VPC cutover + checklist

Alex / team —

Per our recent runbook sync, we've scheduled a "firesim" run against the target VPC to validate routing, NAT egress, TLS cert propagation, and KV-cache warmup before your cutover window. Please confirm availability for the window below and that SRE will enable packet-capture for the 20:00–20:45UTC slot.

Proposed window: Fri 2026-12-18 20:00–20:45 UTC
Key checks we'll run (high level):
- Control plane reachability (API + healthcheck endpoints)
- TLS handshake and ALB integration (mutual TLS on customer side)
- KV cache priming and cache-hit metrics across peers
- Prefix routing + weighted fallback to hosted model variant
- End-to-end latency (p95 target < 170ms for 8k seq)

Attachments: cutover-checklist-v2.md (draft) — please review the blackout list and rollback hooks. Also attaching a small script that will generate synthetic load consistent with your production 99th-percentile.

Ask: Confirm SRE lead and whether you want us to exercise the canary rollback (we can simulate a failover to hosted variant). If no objections, we'll proceed and share logs + a short readout within 2 hours of completion.

Thanks,
Mateo
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
From: Alex Connor <alex.connor@acme.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: SRE Lead <sre-lead@acme-payments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 16:26:12 -0000
Subject: Re: Firesim run before VPC cutover + checklist

Thanks Mateo — 20:00–20:45 UTC works for the SRE team.

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Please include a check that verifies customer-side egress IP ranges after NAT changes — we've seen sticky sessions fail in previous rollouts.
2) Capture the ALB access logs and send a short mapping of IPs → service nodes so we can match connection failures if they appear.

If you can also run a short 1-minute ramp that includes a 10x spike to simulate sudden load, that would be helpful. Otherwise green to proceed.

—Alex
Alex Connor, Platform Lead — Acme Payments
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Connor <alex.connor@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 19:50:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Firesim run before VPC cutover + checklist

Alex —

Acknowledged. We'll add the NAT egress verification and include ALB access logs in the artifacts. Plan below (short form):

20:00 UTC — baseline healthchecks (0–2m)
20:02 UTC — KV-cache priming (2m)
20:05 UTC — steady load at your normal 95th QPS (15m)
20:20 UTC — 1-minute 10x spike (ramp up 10s / hold 60s / ramp down 10s)
20:22 UTC — failure injection: simulate backend node failure to validate weighted fallback (enable hosted variant fallback)
20:30 UTC — egress IP validation + ALB log correlation
20:40 UTC — cool-down and logs collection

Attachments included: infra-firesim-log.txt (raw run output), cutover-checklist-v2.md (annotated after pre-run), smoke-summary-20261218.pdf (prelim).

Please sign off if SRE is ready for packet-capture and we will kick off at T-5.

Mateo
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: infra-firesim-log.txt (text), cutover-checklist-v2.md (markdown), smoke-summary-20261218.pdf (summary)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ops Team <ops@redwood.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 21:05:18 -0000
Subject: Fwd: Firesim run before VPC cutover + checklist — ops notes

Forwarding the run output and checklist for visibility. Ops: please review infra-firesim-log.txt and flag any unexpected socket resets or TLS negotiation errors. From the preliminary summary I saw:

- TLS handshakes: 100% success during steady load, 3 transient timeouts during the 10x spike (likely client-side retries).
- KV cache hit-rate: warmed to ~88% after priming (target 85%+)
- Fallback tested: hosted variant accepted traffic when we ejected a node; p95 latency increased ~40ms during failover window (within SLA threshold).

If you find anything concerning in the raw logs call me and Mateo immediately. Keeping Hannah in loop to decide whether to proceed with the cutover tomorrow morning.

Marissa
Principal PM, Deployment Ops — Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 18 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0000
Subject: Readout: Firesim run completed — short summary and go/no-go recommendation

Team —

Readout (short): firesim completed at 20:45 UTC. Artifacts uploaded to the runbook link below. Key observations:

- Control plane reachability: PASS
- TLS / ALB: PASS (3 transient timeouts during 10x spike; all recovered automatically)
- KV cache: WARM (steady hit-rate 88%); priming time ~2:10
- Egress IP verification: PASS, all expected prefixes observed in ALB logs
- Failover simulation: HOSTED fallback exercised successfully; p95 delta +40ms during 90s window

Known issues (non-blocking):
- Two client-side sockets reset during spike; logs indicate client keepalive timers triggered. Ops to monitor after cutover for increase in resets.
- Small spike in 5xx (0.07% during the minute-level spike) — not reproducible in a follow-up 10-minute steady load.

Recommendation: GO for scheduled cutover tomorrow morning with standard rollback hooks in place. Rollback plan summarized here:
- If >=0.5% sustained 5xx for 3 minutes OR sustained p95 > 300ms for 5 minutes, initiate rollback to previous configuration and trigger hosted-model fallback.

Next steps:
1) Mateo — please upload final annotated checklist to the runbook and share link to the doc (done).
2) Marissa — sync with Ops on monitoring dashboards to ensure alerts are set per thresholds above.
3) SRE (Acme) — keep packet-capture until +2h post-cutover for correlation.

Runbook link: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/vpc-cutover#firesim-20261218
Artifacts: smoke-summary-20261218.pdf, infra-firesim-log.txt, cutover-checklist-v2.md

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Production Readiness, Redwood Inference
